notes: No datacenter projects found in Busan Buk-gu (Korean/English searches). MOTIE opportunity-development-zone designations in nearby reporting refer to Ulsan Buk-gu, not Busan.

name: Koscom Busan Data Center (Jahseong-ro)
notes: Koscom Busan data center at 23 Jahseong-gongwon-ro, Dong-gu (Busan IDC, ~5 floors of the building), part of the KRX/securities-computing ecosystem; Busan city plan (fnnews Jul 2023) also lists expansion of a ~2,000 pyeong Koscom data center near Busan International Finance Center.

name: Korea Securities Depository (KSD) data center on former Jwasung Elementary site
notes: Busan city plan (Jul 2023) to build a KSD data center by 2027 on the closed Jwasung Elementary School site in Dong-gu as part of the financial industry nurturing plan; later progress not confirmed in this pass.

name: Microsoft Busan Data Center 1 (Mieum/Miumsandan, Azure Korea South)
notes: First Microsoft datacenter in Busan at the International Industrial Logistics City / Mieum foreign-investment zone, Gangseo-gu; announced 2014/2016, launched Apr 2020, hosts Azure Korea South; ~50 MW campus capacity per trade blogs (unverified); Microsoft holds rights for up to 6 DCs on ~174,809 sqm.

name: Microsoft Busan Data Center 2 (Miumsandan AI datacenter)
notes: Second and larger Microsoft datacenter in Busan unveiled 23 Sep 2024 in the International Industrial Logistics City (Miumsandan), Gangseo-gu, designed for AI cloud services across Asia-Pacific; no public MW figure.

name: LG CNS Busan Global Cloud Data Center (Mieum)
notes: LG CNS Busan data center at 153 Mieumsandan-ro, Gangseo-gu (Mieum Industrial Estate); operational since 2013, at the time Korea's largest DC; part of the Gangseo cloud-datacenter cluster; capacity not published.

name: OneAsia Network Busan Data Center (Mieum Industrial Park, BJFEZ)
notes: OneAsia's first Korea DC at Mieum Industrial Park in Busan-Jinhae FEZ (Gangseo-gu); ~76,000 sqm site, ~100 MW IT power, immersion cooling; groundbreaking Feb 2024; operational target Q4 2025 per market reports (completion not independently confirmed).

name: Eco Delta City green data center cluster / Data Center Opportunity Development Zone (Myeongji-dong)
developer: Busan Eco Delta Green DC PFV; Empyrion DC consortium; BEP & Mirae Asset consortium; Ellis Group
notes: City-designated green data center cluster on a 177,080 sqm data-industry site in Eco Delta City, Gangseo-gu (Myeongji-dong). Feb 2024 MOU with 4 anchor investors (~KRW 3.6 trillion, ~5 green DCs); Feb 2026: 1.22M sqm of Eco Delta City designated a Data Center Opportunity Development Zone (14 firms, KRW 5.36 trillion, 500 MW-scale shared receiving substation). KEPCO building a 1,000 MW substation in Gangseo-gu (2027). Cluster full-operation capacity up to ~360 MW.

name: EGIS Asset Management AI Data Center (Myeongji-Noksan National Industrial Complex)
notes: MOU 17 Jun 2025 between Busan city and EGIS Asset Management for KRW 1.8 trillion to build two AI-specialized DCs (10- and 13-story) at Myeongji-Noksan National Industrial Complex (Noksan-dong, Gangseo-gu); groundbreaking targeted 2026; ~105 MW reported by trade blogs (unverified).

name: BNK Financial Group Data Center
notes: BNK Financial Group data center in the International Industrial Logistics City cloud-DC cluster, Gangseo-gu (per Yonhap May 2016 alongside LG CNS and Daum Kakao); Busan Ilbo (Apr 2026) confirms BNK built and operates a DC in Busan. Capacity not published.

name: MJY Partners Gijang data center SPC (lead)
notes: Company website (LANDMARK-CND) states a Busan Gijang-gun data center SPC was established in 2022 with MJY Partners; no site, capacity, or construction evidence found. Context: Gijang hosts Busan's nuclear complex (Kori/Shin-Kori) and in 2026 was selected for Korea's first i-SMR, explicitly to power AI data center demand - future siting potential only.

name: KT Cloud Songjeong Global Hub Center (GHC)
notes: KT Cloud's 14th data center, opened 23 May 2024 in Songjeong, Haeundae-gu, adjacent to the KT Busan International Telecom Center (landing station for 7 submarine cables linking US/Japan/Singapore); global hub/international interconnection role; no capacity published.

name: Digital Edge DC PUS1 (Centum City)
notes: Digital Edge PUS1 colocation at 32 Centum 7-ro, Centum City, Haeundae-gu; only Korea DC integrated with a Cable Landing Station; capacity not published.

name: KT Busan IDC (KTICC, near Busan Station)
notes: KT operates a Busan IDC/colocation point at the Busan Telephone Information Center (Jung-gu, near Busan Station) plus a Busan DR center linked to Seoul; Busan Ilbo (Apr 2026) lists KT among operators running DCs in Busan. Small/medium facility; capacity not published.

name: Koramco Busan Jangrim Data Center (Koramco Jangrim IDC)
notes: Koramco announced 29 Aug 2025 development of a 'Massive' data center in Jangrim-dong, Saha-gu, Busan: ~46,900 sqm floor area, 40 MW utility power (sucheon capacity), ~KRW 5.8 trillion-scale project within Koramco's KRW 5 trillion DC fund plan through 2028; construction start planned as of Aug 2025.

name: Sasang-gu data center cluster (Eomgung-dong)
notes: Sasang-gu and Boram Group agreed (Sep 2023) to swap land in Eomgung-dong to build a data center cluster anchoring a global IT industrial complex; local-government MOU/plan stage; no capacity or timeline published.
No datacenter projects found in Busan Seo-gu; Busan's main DC activity is in Gangseo-gu (Microsoft, LG CNS, Eco Delta) outside this division.
No commercial datacenter projects in Yeongdo-gu; only R&D concept coverage on seawater-cooled data centers by KIOST (located in Yeongdo-gu).

name: D&R Partners Eumbong AI data center (Asan)
notes: Investment MOU signed 30 Mar 2026 with Chungcheongnam-do and Asan-si: 100MW AI data center on 119,339 sqm in Asan Eumbong-myeon, KRW 1.5 trillion by Mar 2029, ~300 new jobs.

name: Maltani Eumbong AI data center (Asan)
notes: MOU signed 30 Mar 2026 with Chungcheongnam-do and Asan-si: 80MW AI data center on 38,520 sqm in Asan Eumbong-myeon, KRW 850 billion by Mar 2029, ~200 jobs. Two AI DCs concentrated in Asan Eumbong area.

name: Woongcheon E-Campus AI data center (Boryeong)
notes: MOU signed 18 Nov 2025 with Chungcheongnam-do and Boryeong-si (Hankyoreh/Kyunghyang): KRW 2 trillion by 2029 to build a 100MW AI hyperscale DC on 103,109 sqm at Woongcheon Industrial Complex, Boryeong; ~150 local hires first; PPP-type financing.
No datacenter projects found in Buyeo-gun; Chungnam AI DC investments are in Boryeong, Dangjin, Cheonan, Asan.

name: Geumgang Jiksan AI data center (Cheonan)
notes: MOU signed 29 Jan 2026 with Chungcheongnam-do and Cheonan-si: 80MW AI data center on 102,642 sqm at Jiksan-eup Gunseo-ri, KRW 1.2 trillion by 2029; land secured and 80MW KEPCO power-use agreement completed; ~200 jobs.

name: KT Cloud Cheonan Data Center (existing facility)
notes: Existing colocation/cloud data center in Cheonan operated by KT Cloud (KT's national IDC list includes Cheonan); KT Engineering history records 'KT Gimhae/Cheonan data center construction' around 2012. Capacity not published in cited sources.
